verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken layout. The photo is shrunk to a small thumbnail and pushed against the right edge, with pink corner triangles blown up over the model's face. The three label bars are right-aligned and spaced unevenly (the gap before 'Photography' is much larger), and a huge empty black area runs down the left side and the middle. B is the same layout moved up, which leaves about 200px of dead black at the bottom. A sits slightly more centred vertically, so it is marginally less lopsided.
